title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce. One pan.

steps.text: Dice the onion and pepper and mince the garlic.
Sauté the onion and pepper in olive oil over medium heat until soft.
Add garlic, cumin and paprika and stir until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes, season with salt, and simmer until slightly thickened.
Make four wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are runny.
Top with crumbled feta and parsley and serve with bread.
